description: JSON Schema for the All The Bacteria Bakta index file.

status.description: the status of the Bakta run (PASS, FAIL)

file_name.description: the name of the Bakta JSON result file, e.g. SAMN38372697.bakta.json

tar_xz.description: the name of the tar.xz file where this sample's JSON lives following a fix schema: atb. analysis . release . batch .tar.xz, e.g. atb.bakta.r0.2.batch.1.tar.xz

tar_xz_size_MB.description: size of the tar_xz file in MB

title: All the Bacteria Bakta index file schema
